metadata.description: The heading over the form of a page's metadata: its address, its title and its description.

title.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for a page's title: what the browser's tab and search engines show.

slugHint.defaultMessage: Lowercase words joined by hyphens. The home page is index.
slugHint.description: The hint under a page's slug field: how a slug is written, and the slug the home page takes.

description.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for a page's description: what search engines show under its title.

body.description: The label of the rich text editor for what is written on a page.

bodyEmpty.description: What stands in for what is written on a page when there is nothing: an invitation to click and start writing.
